a2-226.title: Communicative Challenge: A Flat Phone
a2-226.scenario: Meg and Károly are on the metro. Meg's phone has run out of battery and there is no signal.
a2-226.prompt: Tell Károly that your phone has run out of battery and ask whether he has a charger on him.
cues: Say your phone has run out of battery
Ask if he has a charger on him
a2-226.target: Lemerült a mobilom. Van nálad töltő?
a2-226.english: My phone has run out of battery. Do you have a charger on you?
a2-226.canDo: I can say my phone has run out of battery and ask someone for a charger.

a2-227.title: Communicative Challenge: The Wifi Password
a2-227.scenario: Meg is at her colleague Petra's flat and wants to get online. Petra is in the kitchen.
a2-227.prompt: Ask Petra for the wifi password and for her e-mail address, and say that you are sending her a file.
cues: Say you are sending her a file
a2-227.target: Mi a wifi jelszó? És mi az e-mail címed? Küldök neked egy fájlt.
a2-227.english: What is the wifi password? And what is your e-mail address? I'm sending you a file.
a2-227.canDo: I can ask for the wifi password and give or ask for an e-mail address.

a2-228.title: Communicative Challenge: Tickets in the App
a2-228.scenario: Meg and Károly want to go to a concert. Meg has the ticket app open on the sofa.
a2-228.prompt: Tell Károly that you booked two tickets for the concert in the app and paid by card.
cues: Say you booked two tickets in the app
a2-228.target: Az alkalmazásban foglaltam két jegyet a koncertre, és kártyával fizettem.
a2-228.english: I booked two tickets for the concert in the app, and I paid by card.
a2-228.canDo: I can say that I booked, ordered or paid for something in an app.

a2-229.title: Communicative Challenge: The Frozen Computer
a2-229.scenario: Meg is writing a report at work. Her computer froze, but it works again now. Her colleague Petra sits at the next desk and asks what happened.
a2-229.prompt: Tell Petra that your computer froze and that you restarted it.
a2-229.english: My computer froze, but I restarted it.
a2-229.canDo: I can say that my computer or phone froze and that I restarted it.

a2-230.title: Communicative Challenge: A Call to South Africa
a2-230.scenario: It is Sunday. Meg and Károly are on a video call with Meg's mother in South Africa. The picture is good, but the sound is gone.
a2-230.prompt: Tell your mother that you can see her but cannot hear her, and that you are switching the sound on.
cues: Say you are switching the sound on
a2-230.target: Látlak, de nem hallak. Egy pillanat, bekapcsolom a hangot.
a2-230.english: I can see you, but I can't hear you. One moment, I'm switching the sound on.
a2-230.canDo: I can say whether I can see and hear someone on a video call.

a2-230-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Call Was Cut Off
a2-230-consolidation.scenario: Meg's video call to South Africa has just broken off. Károly is sitting next to her.
a2-230-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that the call was cut off because the computer froze, and that you are restarting it.
cues: Say the call was cut off
a2-230-consolidation.target: Megszakadt a hívás, mert lefagyott a számítógép. Újraindítom.
a2-230-consolidation.english: The call was cut off because the computer froze. I'm restarting it.
a2-230-consolidation.canDo: I can solve a small technology problem: say what froze or ran out of battery and what I did about it.
